Method of Attack: Uses DNS-SD printer discovery via broadcast messages to exploit CUPS vulnerabilities

Attack Vector: Local network exploitation using DNS-SD printer discovery
Indicators of Compromise: Scanning activity from IPs such as 107.170.78[.]108, 134.122.95[.]96, 143.244.47[.]70, and malicious printer definitions hosted at URLs like http://172.232.150[.]214:12345/printers/vul_scanning

Attack Vector: Exploitation of UDP port 631 through malicious printer installation and triggered print jobs
